reviews.text:
#Literary Neighborhood #Young Writer Award
#oriental calligraphy

As I was walking down the street, a bookstore caught my eye and I bought a copy of the Young Writer Award-winning book to get acquainted with the writing of today's generation. As I turned the cover, I was greeted by the handwritten autographs of all the award-winning authors. It is, after all, a youthful performance. I stood at the checkout counter after purchasing two volumes of The Future of Space by humanities architect Yoo Heon-jun, and Noh Young-sim was standing inside the counter. Still looks young. Hyehwa-dong Rotary Dongyang Seorim is a bookstore founded in 1953 by Lee Soon-kyung, the daughter of historian Lee Byeong-do. I moved a couple of times and settled in my current location. Mrs. Lee is the wife of artist Jang Wook-jin. The bookstore was inherited by Choi Joo-bo, who had worked as a clerk for many years, and is now run by Choi's daughter. When the bookstore first opened, the blue stream of Heungdeok-dong Stream flowed in front of the store, and people would have gone to and from school.

reviews.text:
I was looking for a good snow crab restaurant, so I went there because of the good reviews, and it was really delicious! It's enough as a place to entertain family or friends, and even if you go with a couple, you'll be satisfied haha.
Please note that parking space is limited!
I had the snow crab lunch special.
Food: It comes as a course meal, but the last crab is served about 30 minutes after ordering, so don't fill yourself up too much! Sushi, raw fish, salad, etc. were served and it was delicious both in taste and appearance! At the end, the spicy soup was delicious.
Service: The lady is really friendly! Thanks to you, I feel good about eating~
Atmosphere: Overall, it was neat and clean. I was able to focus on the food in a quiet atmosphere.

The price isn't that cheap (since crabs are usually expensive...), it came to about 110,000 won for two people!
It’s a place worth visiting at least once without regret!

There is an aquarium on the first floor, and it smells delicious from steaming seafood and smoke.
There is an aquarium on the first floor.
To eat, take the elevator to the 3rd floor.

There was snow crab, king crab, and another one.
I ate king crab.
It was about 90,000 won per kg. Three people ate the crab in the photo.

You can choose between meals with or without side menus.
Even if I didn't eat the side menu, salad, corn butter, okonomiyaki, and white kimchi were served as appetizers.
If you don't eat the side menu, there is an additional 5,000 won for the table setting.
When I ate it, even without the side menu, there was plenty of king crab, so it was enough and I was full.

It takes about 20 minutes to prepare the king crab, so you have to wait patiently.
The king crab was so meaty and prepared that it was easy to eat, so I was able to eat it whole.
It was a bit salty and the only sauce was hot sauce.
I think I would have eaten more crab if there had been wasabi or mustard sauce.

I use white kimchi to control the greasiness. Still, it was an opportunity to eat king crab without any regrets.

Next time, I want to visit again to eat snow crab.

reviews.text: Chicken Doritang is very delicious. When you order potato pancakes, they grate the potatoes on a grater and fry them on the spot, which is excellent. The price is reasonable and very good for a group dinner.

reviews.author: YS Song
reviews.text:
In general, it's an old-fashioned pub-style bar that's hard to find in Hongdae, where people in their teens and twenties hang out, and it's good for drinks.
The owner has a warm grandmother-like feel. Located right behind the former Seogyo Hotel. Rather than feeling like it's a gourmet restaurant, it's a cozy place where you can stop by and have a drink.

reviews.author: Pretty girl genius
reviews.text: A hidden restaurant with the smell of grandma’s house that I don’t want to disappear. The seasoning is a bit strong, so I usually take it out, add a lot of water and boil it for some more.

reviews.author: Jihoon Lee
reviews.text: The taste was ok, but it seems like the two older ladies are having a hard time running it, and they look very tired...and the sanitary conditions don't seem to be very good.

reviews.author: tomato
reviews.text: It's hard to review the dumplings because I only ate the dumpling hotpot. The dumpling hotpot was delicious and they were friendly. It's good to give them very little rice.

reviews.author: jung min Park
reviews.text:
I go there for a hearty lunch in Hongdae, and the owner of Dooriban is a restaurant that stands out for its value of creating social change. There is trust in making food with reliable ingredients.

Bossam, kalguksu, and dumpling soup are all delicious.

reviews.author: Kim Yuhyeoi
reviews.text: This is a hidden steamed restaurant in Hapjeong, Hongdae that serves delicious kalguksu (noodles made in-house) and dumplings made by the owner himself. Spicy chicken noodle soup and kimchi pancake and potato pancake are my favorite menu items. I'm studying abroad in the U.S. and it's so delicious that it's a dream come true.

reviews.author: Marianne
reviews.text:
1. Dumpling hotpot, life-long dumpling hotpot
2. Interior that feels dated but has character and is neat and clean3. Keep the inside of the bathroom clean too.
4. The two of us ordered the dumpling casserole for two and it was so delicious.

reviews.author: b 9
reviews.text:
This is a place where you can always eat good quality food.
It seems like the main dish is dumpling hotpot, but the bossam is also great.
The meat is so moist that it's not lacking compared to bossam restaurants. The side dishes are presented well, so no matter what you eat, you can say you ate well.

reviews.author: Selina
reviews.text: These pig feet are the best! The seasoning is deeply absorbed and the meat is soft and chewy, captivating your taste buds. It's such an addictive taste that you'll want to keep eating it after just one bite!

reviews.author: CHENHONG (General Graduate School, Department of Living Design) XUE
reviews.text: It's really delicious! The meat is soft and moist without any unpleasant odor, and the more you eat it, the more impressed you become. The seasoning is just right, not too salty, so I keep reaching for it. The side dishes are prepared with great care and are even more delicious when eaten with pig's feet. The staff is friendly and the atmosphere is clean, so it's a place I want to visit often. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Haimi
reviews.text: The restaurant has a diverse menu and the taste is excellent, so I highly recommend it. You can enjoy a delicious meal at a dinner party with friends or with family! The environment of this restaurant is clean and tidy, and the food looks beautiful and tastes great. The variety of dishes to choose from and the prices are affordable, making it a great place to enjoy with the family. It's really good, the color is nice, the price is cheap, and the service is attentive. I was satisfied and will come back next time.
